## Summary

Describe the user-facing and scientific change.

## Validation

- [ ] Unit tests pass locally.
- [ ] Ruff checks pass.
- [ ] Sphinx documentation builds without warnings.
- [ ] New or changed algorithms include a methodological reference.
- [ ] Stochastic behavior is reproducible for a fixed random state.
- [ ] Selection is tested inside a scikit-learn pipeline or cross-validation.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an `Unreleased` entry.

## Licensing and data

- [ ] No restricted dataset or incompatibly licensed implementation is copied.
- [ ] New data sources include provenance and reuse terms.
